"""Camera-guided stove manipulation using only rcb_client RGB-D and proprioception.
Each invocation executes a small reviewed command and records its observations.
"""
import argparse, json, pathlib
import numpy as np
from PIL import Image, ImageDraw
from rcb_client import Robot
OUT=pathlib.Path('/app/runs')

def record(res,label):
    path=OUT/label;res.save(str(path))
    cams=list(res.last)
    mosaic=Image.new('RGB',(640,260*((len(cams)+1)//2)))
    d=ImageDraw.Draw(mosaic)
    for i,cam in enumerate(cams):
        x,y=(i%2)*320,(i//2)*260
        mosaic.paste(Image.fromarray(res.last[cam]),(x,y));d.text((x,y+240),cam,fill='white')
    mosaic.save(path/'mosaic.jpg')
    p=dict(zip(res.meta['proprio']['layout'],res.meta['proprio']['now']))
    print(json.dumps({'run':str(path),'steps':res.meta['control_steps'],'time_left':res.meta['time_left_s'], 'eef':[p[k] for k in ['eef_right_x','eef_right_y','eef_right_z']], 'base':[p[k] for k in list(p)[:4]], 'fingers':[p[k] for k in ['gripper0_right_finger_joint1_pos','gripper0_right_finger_joint2_pos']]}))

def point(label,cam,u,v):
    path=OUT/label;m=json.loads((path/'meta.json').read_text())
    c=m['cameras'][cam];K=np.array(c['intrinsic_cv']);T=np.array(c['cam2world_gl'])
    depth=np.load(path/('depth_'+cam+'.npy')).reshape(-1,240,320)[-1]
    z=float(depth[int(v),int(u)])
    gl=np.array([(u-K[0,2])*z/K[0,0],-(v-K[1,2])*z/K[1,1],-z,1])
    return (T@gl)[:3],z

if __name__=='__main__':
    a=argparse.ArgumentParser();a.add_argument('label');a.add_argument('--action',nargs=12,type=float);a.add_argument('--n',type=int,default=1);a.add_argument('--watch',type=float,default=0)
    args=a.parse_args();r=Robot()
    if args.action is not None:
        res=r.submit('ee_delta',np.tile(args.action,(args.n,1)),include_depth=True,video='none',note=args.label)
    else:res=r.get_obs(seconds=args.watch,include_depth=True,video='none')
    record(res,args.label)
PY
